name: awesome-workflow-engines
desc: A curated list of awesome open source workflow engines

resources.name: Platformeco
resources.desc: Technology platform, allows Product & Project teams easily build micro services using drag & drop UI and operate it, within out of the box cloud and CI/CD tools with deep tracing & monitoring.

resources.name: Workflow Engine
resources.desc: A lightweight .NET and Java workflow engine.

resources.name: Activiti Cloud
resources.desc: is now the new generation of business automation platform offering a set of cloud native building blocks designed to run on distributed infrastructures.

resources.name: Azure Logic Apps
resources.desc: Built on a containerized runtime, deploy and run anywhere to increase scale and portability while automating business-critical workflows.

resources.name: Braze
resources.desc: Power customer-centric interactions between consumers and brands in real-time.

resources.name: Camunda Cloud
resources.desc: A workflow service executing BPMN, providing various language clients, based on the open source project Zeebe ![Stars](https://github.com/zeebe-io/zeebe).

resources.name: Codehooks.io
resources.desc: Serverless backend with a workflow engine for automation and AI, supporting LLM-generated workflows via the codehooks-js NPM package.

resources.name: Embed Workflow
resources.desc: Simple native workflow builder for your end-users

resources.name: Orkes Conductor
resources.desc: Orkes provides Netflix Conductor as a cloud services across all the major cloud providers with enterprise features such as security, integrations and Visual workflow code editor.

resources.name: Google Cloud Workflows
resources.desc: Combine Google Cloud services and APIs to build reliable applications, process automation, and data and machine learning pipelines.

resources.name: Inngest
resources.desc: A scalable, event-driven durable execution platform

resources.name: Zenaton
resources.desc: Workflow engine for data processes and background jobs available in PHP, Node.js, Python and Ruby.

resources.name: Dagger
resources.desc: Dagger is a distributed, horizontally scalable, durable, and highly available orchestration engine in python based on Faust-Streaming for running millions of long running tasks with direct integration with Kafka

resources.name: Oban
resources.desc: Robust job processing in Elixir, backed by modern PostgreSQL or SQLite3
